DC-GPU-THERMAL-LIMIT.name: GPU Thermal Power Limit
DC-GPU-THERMAL-LIMIT.definition: Maximum sustained power draw for inference GPUs, dynamically adjusted by thermal zone monitoring.

DC-AGENT-SESSION.name: Agent Session State
DC-AGENT-SESSION.definition: The lifecycle and context state of an active agent session, including PDD context inheritance.

DC-PDD-INTENT-RETRIEVAL.name: PDD Intent Retrieval
DC-PDD-INTENT-RETRIEVAL.definition: The process by which AI tools retrieve explicitly declared authoritative intent before generation.

DC-MODEL-ROUTING.name: GPU Model Routing
DC-MODEL-ROUTING.definition: The assignment of inference models to specific GPU hardware based on VRAM capacity and thermal constraints.

DC-SWARM-ORCHESTRATION.name: Agent Swarm Orchestration
DC-SWARM-ORCHESTRATION.definition: The decomposition of complex goals into atomic sub-tasks executed by bounded sub-agents inheriting root PDD context.

DC-KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH.name: Knowledge Graph Maintenance
DC-KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH.definition: The structural dependency map of the codebase, with node pruning and relationship tracking.

DC-REVERSA-EXTRACTION.name: Reversa Behavioral Extraction
DC-REVERSA-EXTRACTION.definition: The process of reverse-engineering behavioral specifications from existing code using the Reversa agent framework.

DC-WORKSPACE-SECURITY.name: Workspace Security Scanning
DC-WORKSPACE-SECURITY.definition: Mandatory security scan for every newly provisioned workspace, with failure blocking execution.

DC-CONTEXT-AS-CODE.name: Context-as-Code Manifestation
DC-CONTEXT-AS-CODE.definition: The practice of embedding governance rules as machine-readable, human-auditable context directly alongside code.

DC-AUDIT-TRAIL.name: Computational Audit Trail
DC-AUDIT-TRAIL.definition: The system log of prompt identity, governing intent references, model versions, context inputs, and review outcomes.

prompted_by.description: Tesla P40 repeatedly caused PCIe kernel hangs under sustained inference at default power limits. Three thermal crashes observed in 48 hours.
evidence: Kernel hang logs showing PCIe timeout at >85°C

decisions.statement: The Tesla P40 must not exceed 150W sustained power draw during inference. The gpu_thermal_optimizer.py daemon must enforce dynamic stepping between 150W and 220W based on thermal zone readings. Manual override of power limits is forbidden during inference workloads.

prompted_by.description: During Reversa translation pipeline setup, the question arose whether translated files should be saved alongside originals or overwrite them.
evidence: Conversation b492d731 — user confirmed originals downloadable from source

decisions.statement: All Reversa agent skill translations from Portuguese to English are saved in-place, overwriting the originals. No backup copies are needed because the original repository can be re-downloaded at any time from the upstream source.

prompted_by.description: Governance audit identified that all inference was routed to the Tesla P40, creating a thermal bottleneck. The RTX 3070 (8GB VRAM) was idle during heavy audit workloads.
evidence: Swarm orchestration telemetry showing 100% P40 utilization, 0% RTX 3070

decisions.statement: Heavy inference should be distributed across both GPUs. Models requiring more than 8GB VRAM must route to the Tesla P40. Models that fit within 8GB should prefer the RTX 3070 to distribute thermal load. The RTX 3070 runs on Ollama port 11434, the P40 on port 11435.
